topic: Adding sensor linkage field for locations
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on a requirement to enhance data capture for physical locations (facilities). Specifically, [p1] requested the addition of a field that links non-sensor equipped locations to nearby or similar sensor locations. This linkage would involve providing a list of related sensors based on location similarity.
decisions: A new field will be implemented to link non-sensor locations to lists of associated/nearby sensors.
action_items: Add a ticket detailing the requirement for the linked sensor field.
